title: WEEKNUM ( DATE ( 2010, 2, 14 ), 2 ) is 7

source.quote: The following example returns the week number for February 14, 2010. This calculation assumes weeks begin on Monday.
source.supports: the documented example, with the date given by DATE instead of text

source.quote: The week containing January 1 is the first week of the year and is numbered week 1.

derivation: January 1, 2010 is a Friday, so with Monday weeks week 1 is Jan 1 to 3, week 2 Jan 4 to 10, week 3 Jan 11 to 17, week 4 Jan 18 to 24, week 5 Jan 25 to 31, week 6 Feb 1 to 7, week 7 Feb 8 to 14. February 14 (a Sunday) is the last day of week 7.
